unresolved_added: The three-file reconciliation has no raw row counts, join keys, duplicate rule, missing-value rule, discrepancy definition, deleted-record list, or published 34-row clean table; downstream fits therefore cannot be independently reconstructed.

Moisture tolerance is described as the difference between competitive ranking and moisture niche width, but the direction, scale, units, and ecological interpretation of this constructed index are not defined consistently enough to audit.

The two scatters are used to confirm data validity and the extension-rate proxy without coefficients, uncertainty, residuals, sample labels, alternative proxies, or a predictive-error threshold; they establish at most qualitative directional consistency.

The hierarchical clustering omits distance metric, linkage rule, normalization formula, missing-data handling, and sensitivity to scaling, so the dendrogram and three archetypes are not reproducible from the paper.
K=3 is selected from one elbow curve without resampling, silhouette/gap comparison, stability analysis, or a biological validation target; the plotted coefficient is not formally defined.

Each cluster is reduced to arithmetic mean trait values without cluster size, variance, confidence interval, within-cluster range, or uncertainty propagation, yet these point summaries drive every later scenario.

The four regression transformations are author-selected and fitted/compared on the same 34 records; no pre-specified rationale, cross-validation, holdout set, multiple-comparison control, or model-uncertainty averaging is supplied.

The prose calls H' an arithmetic root mean square, but Equation 2 is the geometric mean cube root of H10*H16*H22; the aggregation name, physical rationale, and sensitivity to zero/negative values are inconsistent.
The star notation is described as 99% and 95% confidence intervals although the table shows no intervals or standard errors; it appears to encode coefficient significance levels instead.
All model p-values are printed as 0.0000 and interpreted as exact evidence; rounding, degrees of freedom, coefficient-specific significance, effect size, and residual diagnostics are absent.

BP p-values above 0.05 are treated as acceptance of the null and proof of no heteroscedasticity. Failure to reject with 34 samples cannot establish homoscedasticity, and test implementation details are missing.

The paper acknowledges predictor dependence but asserts it makes no difference to prediction without holdout evidence; multicollinearity can still inflate prediction uncertainty, destabilize extrapolation, and alter transformed-model selection.
E4 is chosen because adjusted R2=0.4754 is only 0.0002 above E3 and 0.0031 above E1, with nearly identical RMSE; no uncertainty or predictive comparison supports a meaningful superiority claim.

The selected response law has no published training-domain bounds, residual plot, coefficient covariance, prediction interval, influence analysis, or external validation, yet it is transferred to category means and mixtures.

Linear composition-weighted extension and tolerance are assumed without an explicit a1+a2+a3=1 constraint, interaction term, within-cluster variance, or mixture experiment validating that community traits equal weighted means.

Substituting weighted means into a squared and exponential response is not equivalent to averaging species responses; nonlinear aggregation, Jensen effects, composition uncertainty, and interaction-dependent trait changes are ignored.
H is introduced in Table 1 as hyphal extension in mm/day but is used as an intrinsic population-growth coefficient multiplying n; no conversion closes the units of dn/dtau for a strain/m2 state.

The linear rate decline, fixed capacity Nm, and Nm=2000 simulations have no data source or calibration; beyond capacity H(n) becomes negative, and no biological mechanism or uncertainty justifies the form.

The same symbol M denotes moisture and temperature normalization distances with different units and domains. Thresholds and domain extremes are asserted, and no continuity/range/uncertainty test is reported.

The printed middle equality H_i0*n_i(n_i) is undefined/ambiguous, and Equation 13 uses one Nm rather than the category-specific capacities used elsewhere; source ambiguity is preserved rather than silently repaired.
k1 and k2 have no calibration, units, or admissible range; sigma can exceed the logistic margin and force negative growth without a feasibility or positivity analysis.

Eight periodic disturbance cases are announced, but exact amplitudes, frequencies, phases, joint-driver functions, and a complete results matrix are not supplied. Periodic sine scenarios do not answer changing atmospheric trends by themselves.

Competition coefficients are explained through ratios of consumed woody-fiber mass normalized by different capacities, but the index direction, units, and link to the dimensionless ODE terms are not derived or measured.
The conditions sigma21*sigma12<=1, sigma31*sigma13<=1, and sigma23*sigma32<=1 are stated without derivation, interpretation, equality cases, or use in equilibrium/stability analysis.

H, N, and all six directional competition coefficients are hard-coded without source data, fitting method, uncertainty, or sensitivity to coefficient changes; the resulting dominance patterns are therefore constructed scenarios.
Equation 20 uses x and y while Equations 11-14 define x' and y'; the code instead uses u=water(wa) and y=temp(T). Equation-code-symbol parity is ambiguous and only group A is displayed in prose.

Simultaneous temperature and moisture change is treated as superposition of single-driver cases without testing interaction; Equation 14 is additive but the nonlinear ODE response does not make output superposition valid.

Trajectory claims rely on plots without solver tolerances, equilibrium residuals, repeated-run checks, time-step convergence, positivity checks, uncertainty bands, or an explicit rule for stable, peak, balance, or sensitivity.

Each named climate is represented by one web-derived moisture and summer-day temperature value without location, date range, seasonality, distribution, or uncertainty; the arboreal category is especially undefined.

Regional panels use different visible horizons and unlabeled combination mappings; several panels show two lines while conclusions discuss all alternatives, preventing exact reconstruction of each ranking.

Best partner, advantage, and disadvantage have no numeric persistence/coexistence thresholds, objective function, evaluation horizon, or tie/uncertainty rule, so the table cannot be regenerated from the curves.

The single/multiple comparison does not publish a complete matching table or ratio calculation. A single Middle-distance runner is compared with a three-category community, and visual variability is called stability without a metric.

Species count is used as biodiversity without richness/evenness/functional-diversity measures, communities larger than three archetypes, perturbation recovery, or field validation. The population and decomposition metrics also point in opposite directions.

The printed code calls a missing water() function and omits data preparation, clustering, regression, decomposition evaluation, scenario loops, plotting, solver options, and output tables; it cannot reproduce Figures 3-16 or the reported ratios end to end.
